title: EFC Closure Conjectures
description: Proposes two closure relations for Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC): the transition acceleration g† = c H0 / e and a galactic phase factor C = 2e − 1, both motivated by the Core Lock exponential structure. Using SPARC-derived g†, the paper predicts H0 = 70.2 ± 16.8 km/s/Mpc, consistent with Planck, SH0ES, and TRGB within current uncertainties. The conjectures are framed with explicit falsification criteria and remain to be validated by higher-precision measurements.

efc_screening_log.description: EFC screening form for the RAR: the logarithm of the gravitational enhancement factor scales with the logarithm of 1 + g†/gbar with exponent k.

efc_screening_power.description: Equivalent power-law form of the EFC screening relation relating observed-to-baryonic acceleration ratio to g† and k.

transition_acceleration.description: Conjectured closure linking the galactic transition acceleration to the cosmological expansion rate via a single e-fold threshold.

h0_from_gdagger.description: Non-circular test: infer H0 directly from a measured g† without using cosmological data.

phase_factor.description: Conjectured galactic phase factor; compact two-term expression matching current inferences.

k_via_aG.description: Links the screening exponent k to the universal coupling aG via the phase factor C.

core_lock_stiffness.description: Core Lock exponential structure; one e-fold decrease at S = \Delta S motivates the appearance of e in closure relations.

cosmological_phase.description: Heuristic mapping of cosmological phase difference from the Core Lock S-dynamics.

friedmann_offset.description: Stated relation between the H0 offset parameter and the universal coupling aG within the EFC framework.

key_results.main_finding: The closures g† = cH0/e and C = 2e − 1 are consistent with SPARC-inferred g† and yield H0 = 70.2 ± 16.8 km/s/Mpc, within 1σ of Planck, SH0ES, and TRGB.
datasets_used: Comparative H0 values: Planck, SH0ES, TRGB

sealed_predictions.statement: Across independent galaxy samples, the transition acceleration satisfies g† = c H0 / e within 10% once both g† and H0 are measured to <5–10% precision.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: High-precision RAR analyses (e.g., upgraded SPARC-like surveys) plus independent H0 determinations; fail if |g† − cH0/e| > 3σ.

sealed_predictions.statement: The independently inferred galactic phase factor satisfies C = 2e − 1 within ±20% when marginalized over per-galaxy systematics.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Hierarchical fits extracting C and k/aG from resolved rotation curves; fail if |C − (2e − 1)|/(2e − 1) > 0.2.

kill_criteria: KC1: Improved g† measurements with <10% uncertainty are inconsistent with c H0 / e at >3σ using an independent H0.
KC2: Independent hierarchical inferences of the phase factor yield |C − (2e − 1)|/(2e − 1) > 0.2.
KC3: Alternative non-exponential f(S) forms (e.g., power-law or Lorentzian without natural factors of e) provide significantly better RAR fits and predictive performance.
